timing_verdict.label: NEUTRAL
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: NEUTRAL timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: ~1,300–1,420 KRW/USD

WHY: The won has strengthened significantly (132 KRW drop in one month), with the rate now hovering near potential support levels around 1,300–1,420 range. However, analysts are divided—some call this a temporary dip while others expect the won to maintain strength due to corporate tax payments (46 trillion KRW expected) and government stabilization measures. The trend lacks clear directional conviction.

TIP: Since the won appears relatively strong now and forecasts are mixed, lock in your monthly $2,000 conversion consistently to average out timing risk rather than waiting for a "better" rate that may not materialize.
